name: MonarchCursorList
title: CursorList
summary: A list loaded page by page from a cursor: the items, a Load more footer with a count, and the first-load, empty and error states.
whenToUse: For a feed of records that arrive in pages from an API cursor: tickets, activity, audit events, search results.
whenNotToUse: For a list that arrives whole, use a LazyColumn. For rows people sort and compare by column, use a table. For numbered pages people jump between, use a pager.
api: @Composable fun <T> MonarchCursorList(items: List<T>, label: String, hasMore: Boolean, onLoadMore: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, key: ((item: T) -> Any)? = null, loading: Boolean = false, failed: Boolean = false, totalCount: Int? = null, autoLoad: Boolean = false, showEnd: Boolean = true, divided: Boolean = true, focusNewItems: Boolean = true, loadingVariant: MonarchLoadingStateVariant = MonarchLoadingStateVariant.List, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), contentPadding: PaddingValues = PaddingValues(), onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, empty: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchCursorListLabels = MonarchCursorListLabels(), row: @Composable LazyItemScope.(item: T) -> Unit)

class MonarchCursorListLabels(loading: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, errorTitle: String? = null, retry: String? = null, footer: MonarchLoadMoreLabels = MonarchLoadMoreLabels())

options.name: items
options.description: Every item loaded so far, in order.

options.name: label
options.description: The TalkBack name of the list.

options.name: hasMore
options.description: Whether there is another page. With no items and no more, the empty state is shown.

options.name: onLoadMore
options.description: Loads the next page.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the list. Give it a bounded height.

options.name: key
options.description: A stable key per item, as for LazyColumn. null uses the position.

options.name: loading
options.description: A page is being fetched. With no items the placeholder is shown; otherwise the footer button shows progress.

options.name: failed
options.description: The last fetch failed. With no items the error state is shown; otherwise the footer shows the failure with Retry.

options.name: totalCount
options.description: The total, when the server knows it, for "Showing 20 of 140 items".

options.name: autoLoad
options.description: Loads the next page when the footer scrolls into view; the button stays. Pauses after a failure.

options.name: showEnd
options.description: Shows "That's everything" after the last page.

options.name: divided
options.description: Draws a MonarchDivider between rows.

options.name: focusNewItems
options.description: Moves focus to the first item of a page asked for from the footer button.

options.name: loadingVariant
options.description: The shape of the first-page placeholder.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the list.

options.name: contentPadding
options.description: Padding around the rows and the footer.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Repeats the failed request. null calls onLoadMore.

options.name: empty
options.description: Replaces the empty state, for example with a MonarchEmptyState that has a first-run action.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the strings monarch_cursorlist_*, and footer for the MonarchLoadMore strings.

options.name: row
options.description: Draws one item. Put a clickable row inside when the item opens something.

states.name: ready
states.description: The rows and the footer: a Load more button with the count, or the end line.

states.name: loading more
states.description: The footer button shows progress and ignores taps.

states.name: failed later
states.description: The footer shows "Couldn't load more." with Retry; the rows stay.

states.name: first page failed
states.description: A small MonarchErrorState, "This list could not be loaded", with Retry; while the retry runs the button is busy.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState, "Nothing here yet" with a message, or the empty slot.

appearance: The app's rows separated by subtle dividers, then the MonarchLoadMore footer: the count in muted caption text and a small secondary button. The first-load, error and empty states are the shared Monarch states in their small size. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web CursorList chooses ul or ol and takes an item class; on Android it is a LazyColumn and the row lambda draws each item, so it must have a bounded height and must not sit in a vertically scrolling parent. The web moves keyboard focus to the first new item after a page asked for by keyboard; on Android focus moves to it after a page asked for from the footer button (by touch, keyboard or TalkBack), and auto-loaded pages do not move focus. The web noun is built into its messages; on Android pass labels.footer.count and labels.footer.loaded. The same name and options as iOS, with Android's state names (loading, failed, autoLoad, showEnd, divided, focusNewItems) and the added key, state and contentPadding of LazyColumn.
accessibility: The list is named by label.
The footer is a MonarchLoadMore: its button has a 48dp touch target, and new items, a failure and the end are announced through a polite live region.
After a page asked for from the footer arrives, focus moves to its first new item; that item takes focus only until focus leaves it.
The first-load placeholder, the error state and the empty state are the shared Monarch states with their own names; Retry has a 48dp touch target.
The empty message wraps at the largest font size.
edgeCases: With no items, hasMore true and nothing loading, the list shows only the footer so people can load the first page.
A failure with items keeps the items and shows the failure in the footer; a failure without items replaces the list with the error state.
Whether TalkBack's own focus follows the moved input focus depends on the device; a device check is needed.
The empty slot ignores modifier: apply it to the slot's content.
